registry_patch.wiki_article: Monetary Dark Matter is a theoretical paper in the Semantic Economy sequence. It argues that money can enter a field only after constitutive labor has already made that field identifiable, related, transmissible, and provenance-bearing, and that monetary operation may then shear away relations that remain causally load-bearing. The paper distinguishes monetary dark matter from mere missing information and defines productive provenance shear for cases in which a relation's loss of operative standing increases monetary capacity. Its monetary-body specimen separates denomination from a second singular price, while its provenance analysis distinguishes authorizing from obligating relations. Version 0.2 also develops the transition bridge: standing is factored into latency and activation, reassimilation is modeled as descriptive retention without operative force, and the Baal counter-transition is given a distinct exposure law in which circulating carrier stock, cumulative exposure, latent power, and activation are separate state variables. The appendix leaves the counter-transition formally incomplete where monetary grammar, carrier identity, and substrate writeability remain to be operationalized.

defines_concepts.definition: An evidence-supported relation excluded from operative monetary standing that remains constitutively or causally load-bearing for the monetary result or the capacities it enables.
A monetary shear in which loss of operative standing of a specific relation increases the monetary capacities of the resulting object or position.
Provenance whose activation can alter permission, distribution, attribution, ownership, liability, settlement, or recognized standing.
The realized price of a singularized monetary body minus its denomination.
A negative feedback in which withdrawal of inscription-bearing monetary carriers lowers carrier stock and thereby lowers the future rate of exposure production.
The conversion of an activated claim back into dark matter: descriptively retained while its operative standing is neutralized.
